scripts.build: native build && native package --target macos --binary 'zig-out/bin/Idfon' --output 'Idfon.app' && cp ../target/release/idfond 'Idfon.app/Contents/MacOS/idfond' && cp zig-out/bin/libiroh_c_ffi.dylib 'Idfon.app/Contents/MacOS/'
scripts.release: pnpm run build && codesign --force --timestamp -s 'Developer ID Application: WizOps LLC (RV27HPQNMF)' Idfon.app/Contents/MacOS/libiroh_c_ffi.dylib Idfon.app/Contents/MacOS/idfond Idfon.app && hdiutil create -srcfolder Idfon.app -volname Idfon -format ULMO -ov Idfon.dmg && codesign --timestamp -s 'Developer ID Application: WizOps LLC (RV27HPQNMF)' Idfon.dmg
